segments.label: Launch & ascent — Kennedy Space Center LC-39A
segments.note: SpaceX Falcon 9 from Kennedy Space Center LC-39A (28.608°, -80.604°); ~9 min analytic ascent to a 185 km parking orbit (schematic arc, real pad and launch time).

segments.label: Parking orbit coast
segments.note: Circular 185 km parking orbit, inclination 28.7° (plane through the pad at launch and the Moon at arrival — the launch-window geometry). Coast 33 min to the trans-lunar injection burn.

segments.label: Trans-lunar coast (6.3 days)
segments.note: Two-body Lambert arc from the TLI point to the modeled LOI point (Moon's position from the ephemeris at LOI). Departure Δv 3140 m/s, arrival v∞ 0.86 km/s. Mid-course corrections not modeled.

segments.label: Lunar orbit (~72 km, 16.3 rev)
segments.note: Circular orbit after LOI (published 92 km; modeled 72 km so that the orbit reaches the descent-orbit-insertion point exactly at DOI). Plane contains the arrival asymptote and the landing site; inclination 81.5°.

segments.label: Descent orbit (72 × 15 km)
segments.note: Descent-orbit insertion lowers perilune to 15 km opposite the powered-descent point; 0.5 revolutions to PDI (DOI modeled at 2024-02-22T22:14:19Z, published 2024-02-22T22:10:00Z).

segments.label: Powered descent & landing
segments.note: Powered descent integrated for the lander class (Nova-C class (Intuitive Machines): 4.0 kN, Isp 340 s, 1622 kg at PDI): 15.1 min, Δv 1998 m/s. Model, not telemetry. Published duration ≈12 min.

notes: Route reconstructed from published event times and sites with two-body orbital mechanics — the shape between the anchors is a model, not flight telemetry.

Anchors: launch 06:05:37 UTC (KSC LC-39A), Falcon 9 second-stage TLI ≈T+40 min, LOI Feb 21 (408 s burn, 800 m/s, 92 km circular), DOI/PDI Feb 22 evening UTC, touchdown 23:23 UTC near Malapert A. Hours marked ≈ are approximate.
Lander stats for the descent model: Nova-C class (4 kN VR900, Isp 340 s, ≈1,500 kg at PDI).
